description:
Connector marketplace backend (#150): a curated, searchable catalog of connector
        manifests (the notification-focused family + storage/payment) ON TOP OF the connectors-api install
        service. Indexes shipped manifests from classpath*:marketplace/*.yaml at startup, exposes a
        catalog list/detail/search API, validates user-supplied (BYO) manifests WITHOUT installing, and
        installs catalog or BYO manifests through IConnectorInstallService. Unlike connectors-api (which is
        service-only), this module ALSO ships a UI-facing MarketplaceController (like dynamic-apis) gated on
        spring-web being present + a property, since the catalog is a UI surface.
